title: The Clocktower
intro: Giant gears grind in the dark. The clock has been striking thirteen for a hundred years. The mechanism box in the middle of the gears needs the right code.

objects.label: Cuckoo Door
objects.reward_text: The tiny door bursts open and a shrieking face leaps out.

objects.label: Bell Rope
objects.reward_text: The spirit is amused. It whispers: 'Everything in this room is connected. Finish what you started.'

a_gear: Count routes tile by tile: the routes to a tile = routes to the tile above + routes to the tile on its left.
A collapsed tile has 0 routes. Start with the top-left tile = 1 and fill the grid row by row.
The answer is 38. The vault's character number 1 is 6.
b_pendulum: Start with the biggest group size (7) and list the numbers that leave the right remainder.
Check each of those numbers against the other conditions.
The answer is 36. The vault's character number 2 is F.
c_face: You need exactly (width) steps right and (height) steps up, in some order.
The number of routes is the number of ways to choose which steps are 'right'.
That is C(7, 4), the number of ways to choose 4 items from 7.
The answer is 35. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are V and 4.
dare_rope: A dare is optional and never needed to leave the floor.
It never costs you anything to skip it.
Do the dare only if you and your team are happy with it.
It never owns part of the vault code. Skip it freely.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Brass Gear, Pendulum, Clock Face.
